title: Add analogy-aware explanation mode to agent responses
body_excerpt: Feature request: when a developer provides an analogy ('think of this agent as a junior developer'), the AI agent (Copilot, Cursor) should frame its uncertainty using that metaphor. Similar to how a junior dev would ask for clarification.
author: demo_user_0

title: Document: AI Ready wiki — two-engineer analogy for agent collaboration
body_excerpt: This PR adds documentation using the two-engineer collaboration analogy to explain how github copilot agent requires shared mental models, similar to pair programming.
author: demo_user_1

title: Bug: agent sycophancy amplified by self-deprecating analogies
body_excerpt: When I joked that the AI agent was 'like a confused intern', Cursor adopted that framing to justify a wrong answer. The analogy made the error harder to catch. Copilot has similar issue.
author: demo_user_2
